title: Delta T13020-SS Monitor 13 Series Valve-Only Trim, Stainless

comparisons.notes: Delta T13020-SS Classic Monitor 13 Series valve trim, Brilliance Stainless, in stock

amazon_match_notes: Amazon lists Monitor 13 Series Valve Only Trim, DELTA model T13020-SS, stainless, same as Woot's ASIN
writeup: Delta's T13020-SS is the Classic Monitor 13 Series valve-only shower trim in Brilliance Stainless, with a single lever and a pressure-balance cartridge that holds temperature within about 3 degrees. It needs a Delta MultiChoice R10000 rough-in valve, sold separately. PlumbersStock sells it for $90.80.
